note: Kalawao County has no county government or zoning; it is administered by the Hawaii Dept. of Health and has no cities or towns. The state ParcelsZoning service's Maui County zoning layer (MapServer/33) returns only 'Not Zoned' (ZONE_DIST, Molokai) at the county's point, and no other public zoning service covers Kalawao. Equator's commercial portal is not an official source.
